    Bands as block quivers #

    A cyclic word is a nonempty closed walk l_0 ⋯ l_{n-1} at v; position i (in Fin n) lies over the start of l_i, and l_i joins positions i and i + 1. Given an automorphism φ of a block space V, the band block quiver has the moves of the letters, the identity on all moves except the one of l_{n-1}, which carries φ (or φ⁻¹ if l_{n-1} is inverse).
